title: Langy original lemma challenge key
provenance: Original sentences and explicit target annotations authored and reviewed by the OpenAI assistant for Langy. Not independently human-adjudicated; report separately from the published UD reference sets.
conventions: Only the listed targets are scored; unannotated context is not an error.
NFC and casefold normalization preserve stress accents and ñ.
Attached pronouns and contractions expand into multiple lemmas at one source span.
Spanish pronoun targets follow the AnCora singular-person convention: me -> yo; se/lo -> él.
Lexical noun gender remains distinct; adjective inflections use their citation form.
Mandarin cases check individual Han characters, not word lemmas.
